title: the cairn device has its own launcher
intention: The cairn device carries a self-named launcher at cairn/devices/cairn/0/bin/cairn, so the floor lays ~/.cairn/devices/cairn/0/bin/cairn on every box like every other device's, instead of a box reading green only on a hand-placed file.
why: Measured 2026-11-12: cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_cli_reaches.py is red on akienasus for the cairn device (three teeth: instance bin, self-named launcher, resolves). cairn/devices/cairn has no 0/bin in class-space and git shows cairn/devices/cairn/0/bin/cairn never existed, so the walk has nothing to link. akiendelllinux reads green on a hand-placed file dated Sep 2 with an old print-only body: armed by hand, not unwired.
traces_to: Law 4 (enforced by physics: the walk lays it, no hand); Law 9 (the Dell's green was not earned by the build).
how: Add cairn/devices/cairn/0/bin/cairn, cli_main over CairnShim, shaped like cairn/devices/tester/0/bin/tester. The top-level shortcuts at cairn/devices/cairn/bin/ (start, stop, restart) stay where they are: bin/cairn:344-349 dispatches them (outline 5.4.3.5). The existing walk (cairn_wire_instances, with 96c1's _floor_wiring_gap) lays the link; no walk change. LIVE FIRE at PROVEME: on its tree turn the orchestrator removes akiendelllinux's hand-placed ~/.cairn/devices/cairn/0/bin/cairn (the walk leaves a hand-placed real file standing), runs any bin/cairn command so the floor lays the link, and runs test_cli_reaches; akienasus does the same run without a removal.

clauses.claim: a scratch box's wiring walk links devices/cairn/0/bin/cairn to the class file cairn/devices/cairn/0/bin/cairn
that linked launcher, run with no arguments, exits 0 and prints device: cairn

decisions.text: D1: the class launcher, cli_main over CairnShim, shaped like tester's.
D2: the proof over 96c1's scratch box (scratch instance root, scratch socket dir, stand-in sudo), one tooth per clause.

measured.saw: test_cli_reaches red on akienasus for cairn: no ~/.cairn/devices/cairn/0/bin/cairn
cairn/devices/cairn/0/bin/cairn never existed in git; the Dell's file is a regular file dated Sep 2
measured.how: git log --all -- cairn/devices/cairn/0/bin, and ls -l on akiendelllinux via cc_0

measured.saw: the proof is red against HEAD (both teeth) and green twice with the build
measured.how: bin/cairn test on the proof with cairn/devices/cairn/0 moved aside, then restored
